query:
WITH live AS (
                SELECT id FROM job_executions WHERE id = $1 FOR SHARE
            )
            INSERT INTO job_waiters (job_id, waiter_job_id, created_at)
            SELECT live.id, $2, COALESCE($3, NOW()) FROM live
            ON CONFLICT (job_id, waiter_job_id) DO UPDATE SET woken_at = NULL
            RETURNING job_id
